decisions.reason: The classic lever line sits close to the core range and costs little to keep, so it stays even though it has not been visible on the website since 2019.

This single design carries little sunk investment and no public commitment, and having already pruned similar handle designs B and C, management makes it the most likely candidate for pruning, but not enough to drop it yet.
The multi-model lever family carries sunk tooling investment and supports the announced push for system breadth, so management persists with it despite weak visibility.

The L700 access system is the publicly announced flagship of the firm's digital building direction with heavy investment, so any weak results would be attributed to temporary market causes and the firm sticks with it.
